_note: What Kota says when the farmer talks to them (Talk, README.md, Villagers): the first pick whose if holds names the lines, one of them by the day; the gift_ lines answer a gift by its reaction (gift_birthday on their birthday) (gifts in data/villagers/kota.json). Our own lines.

lines.speaker: kota
lines.text: Guess what! I'm a whole year older today. Mum made red rice and everything.

lines.speaker: kota
lines.text: Wait, did you know already? Did Sayo tell you?

lines.speaker: kota
lines.text: A birthday present? For me?! I'm keeping this forever. Well, until I eat it.

lines.speaker: kota
lines.text: What? I'm busy! ...Okay, I'm not busy.

lines.speaker: kota
lines.text: You keep coming back. Are you lonely up on that farm?

lines.speaker: kota
lines.text: I saw the streamer from the pond path! It was flapping like it was swimming upstream.

lines.speaker: kota
lines.text: Mum says I talk about your farm more than about school. That's because school is boring.

lines.speaker: kota
lines.text: When the wind drops, the carp streamer looks sleepy. Like the real one under the willow.

lines.speaker: kota
lines.text: When I grow up I'm gonna have a farm too. Bigger than yours!

lines.speaker: kota
lines.text: ...Can I help with the watering sometime?

lines.speaker: kota
lines.text: I'll show you my secret fishing spot. Don't tell Hachiro.

lines.speaker: kota
lines.text: Whoa, who are you? Oh, the new farm. I'm Kota!

lines.speaker: kota
lines.text: Grandma Tome says I talk too much. I don't talk too much.

lines.speaker: kota
lines.text: Shh! There's a big one under the lily pads. I saw it.

lines.speaker: kota
lines.text: Nothing's biting. The fish are all asleep today.

lines.speaker: kota
lines.text: I've got six cicadas! No, seven. One got out.

lines.speaker: kota
lines.text: Did you hear that one? It's the loudest in the whole shrine!

lines.speaker: kota
lines.text: If it snows, I'm making a snowman as big as the torii.

lines.speaker: kota
lines.text: I can run from my house to the shrine in forty steps. Wanna see?

lines.speaker: kota
lines.text: Sayo gives me a dango if I help carry the rice. Best job ever.

lines.speaker: kota
lines.text: Is it true you've got a pond on your farm? Any koi?

lines.speaker: kota
lines.text: No way! For me? For real?

lines.speaker: kota
lines.text: You're the best! I'm showing everybody!

lines.speaker: kota
lines.text: Ooh, thanks! That's pretty good.

lines.speaker: kota
lines.text: Huh. Okay. Thanks, I guess.

lines.speaker: kota
lines.text: Yuck... do I have to? ...Thanks.

lines.speaker: kota
lines.text: Bleh! Mum makes me eat those. No way!

lines.speaker: kota
lines.text: You already gave me stuff today. Grandma says don't be greedy.
